{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the revenue column: it's stored as string with commas
print(sales['revenue'].head())

# Convert revenue to numeric: remove commas and cast to float
sales['revenue_numeric'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Verify the conversion
print(sales['revenue_numeric'].head())

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue_numeric'] == 999999.99]
print(f'Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}')

# Drop QA orders and refunded orders
sales_clean = sales[(sales['revenue_numeric'] != 999999.99) & (sales['status'] == 'completed')]
print(f'Rows after cleaning: {len(sales_clean)}')"}
